title: Output accumulated from emitted symbols
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state multi-tape Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary input, and let $t\in\mathbb{N}$. The output after $t$ steps from the initial configuration on $x$ is the concatenation, in order for times $s=0,\ldots,t-1$, of the optional symbols emitted by the transition prescribed at the snapshot of the run at time $s$; a halted snapshot contributes no symbol.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state multi-tape Turing machine over the binary alphabet
